virality_data.topic: Diagram-as-Code Architecture: Why I Switched from Mermaid to Declarative Canvas Positioning
virality_data.analysis: Developers are notoriously frustrated with auto-layout diagram tools like Mermaid and Graphviz randomly shifting node positions on single-line edits. With Reladraw trending on Hacker News, there is surging interest in declarative diagram systems where developers maintain explicit spatial control in markdown. This post provides an architecture deep-dive comparing layout engine tradeoffs with practical code snippets that readers can adopt immediately.
